string.name: settings_audio_desc
string.value: Sound travels with the picture; turning it off only mutes this device

string.name: settings_enhance_desc
string.value: Upscales and sharpens with the system video engine; adds a little latency

string.name: settings_enhance_unsupported
string.value: This device has no video processing engine

string.name: settings_freeze_desc
string.value: After a lost frame, hold the last good picture until the next keyframe instead of showing artifacts

string.name: settings_keepalive_desc
string.value: Keep receiving for a while after leaving the app so the picture is back instantly

string.name: settings_netopt_desc
string.value: Acknowledge data quickly and ask the system to prioritize the stream

string.name: settings_pip_desc
string.value: Keep playing in a small window when you leave the app

string.name: settings_pip_unsupported
string.value: Picture-in-picture is not supported on this device

string.name: settings_refresh_desc
string.value: Games run at up to 60 fps; dropping a high-refresh screen to 60 Hz saves power and keeps frames even

string.name: settings_stats_desc
string.value: Show link, frame rate, bitrate, latency and sound at the top left while playing
